meta.title: English for me
meta.description: Your personal, roadmap-based English learning companion.

home.headline: Learn English step by step, on your own schedule.
home.subhead: Build a learning roadmap, get reminded when it's study time, check off lessons, and let AI coach you along the way.

roadmap.title: Learning roadmap
roadmap.body: Split your goal into phases and bite-sized lessons.

checkoff.title: Check off lessons
checkoff.body: Tick a lesson when you finish and watch your progress grow.

reminders.title: Smart reminders
reminders.body: Push and email reminders right before study time.

ai.title: AI coach
ai.body: Weekly insights, praise when you're ahead, advice when you fall behind.

practice.title: Practice
practice.lessonHint: Answer a few questions to check what stuck. Anything you get wrong goes into your review list.
practice.none: This lesson has no questions yet.
practice.error: Could not send your answer. Please try again.
practice.wrongQueued: The ones you missed were added to Review.

bands.perfect: Perfect! You have this one down. 🎉
bands.good: Good work! Review the few you missed.
bands.review: No worries — read the lesson again and retry. Mistakes are how it sticks.

review.title: Review your mistakes
review.subtitle: Questions you got wrong come back just before you would forget them.
review.noneHint: Practise inside your lessons — anything you miss shows up here.
review.laterHint: {n} questions will come back over the next few days.
review.howItWorks: How it works: a wrong answer comes back the same day. Each correct answer pushes it out 1 day, then 3, then 7. Three in a row and it is considered learned.
review.cardHint: Reviewing your mistakes sticks better than rushing ahead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Learning preferences used for your schedule, streak and weekly goal.
settings.timezoneHint: Streaks and schedules follow this timezone.

settings.deviceOff: Turn on notifications to get reminders on this device.

settings.iosHint: On iPhone/iPad: open this site in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the app from the home screen and turn on notifications.
